QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_24

question.text: A Cat III AIF must appoint a custodian registered with SEBI for:

answer.text: Safekeeping of the securities/goods of the fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 20 requires the Sponsor/Investment Manager to appoint a custodian registered with SEBI for SAFEKEEPING of securities/goods of the fund. Fund administration, NAV computation and KYC may be outsourced separately; the custodian mandate is safekeeping. The Trap: Each of options A, C, D describes a valid service provider role — but the Reg 20 mandate is specifically safekeeping. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C/D test the same custodian requirement. XXI-B (PMS) has its own custodian rule. Manager's Pro-Tip: Pair custodian with a robust pre-trade limit service — many Indian Cat III funds now use the custodian's platform for pre-trade compliance (concentration, leverage, single-investee limits) so breaches are prevented at order entry.
